categories.main_business_segments: WUS Printed Circuit Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the manufacturing, processing, assembly, and sales of various printed circuit boards (PCBs) and PCB assemblies. The company’s product portfolio includes high-frequency/high-speed transmission boards, 5G application boards, PCIe gen5 connection boards, and military wireless communication boards. It also provides electronic manufacturing services (EMS) for optoelectronics, communications, computers, medical, industrial control, and automotive products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced PCB manufacturing technologies focusing on high-density, high-precision, high-integration, microvia, fine-line, and packaging boards. Production methods include multi-layer PCB fabrication, chemical plating, etching, lamination, drilling, and assembly processes such as surface mount device (SMD) placement, wave soldering, and functional testing. The firm emphasizes automation, intelligent manufacturing, and process optimization to improve yield and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: WUS serves key customers in AI servers, satellite communications, automotive electronics, consumer electronics, industrial and medical electronics, and computer peripherals. Its major markets include network communications, high-performance computing, automotive control systems, and emerging AI edge computing applications. The company’s customers are primarily electronics manufacturers requiring advanced PCB and assembly solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities located in Kaohsiung. Its sales are distributed across Taiwan (approximately 20%), Asia (30%), North America (35%), Europe (15%), and other international markets. The firm also has investments and subsidiaries in China and Singapore, supporting its global supply chain and market reach.
categories.supply_chain_position: WUS operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, focusing on PCB manufacturing and assembly. It sources raw materials such as copper foil, prepreg, and electronic components from upstream suppliers and delivers finished PCBs and assembled modules to downstream electronics manufacturers and OEMs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include enhancing high-performance computing and AI-related PCB products, expanding niche markets, and increasing AI product ratios. R&D efforts focus on developing high-frequency, 5G, PCIe gen5, and military-grade PCBs, as well as future products like AI server thick boards and humanoid robot boards. It also emphasizes smart manufacturing, automation, lean management, and green production to improve competitiveness and sustainability.
categories.revenue_model: WUS generates revenue primarily through product sales of printed circuit boards and PCB assemblies. Revenue streams include direct sales to electronics manufacturers and contract manufacturing services. The company also earns income from investments in subsidiaries but does not rely on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The PCB industry is highly competitive with many domestic and international players. WUS positions itself as a high-quality, reliable PCB supplier with a focus on advanced technology and niche markets. It competes by strengthening customer relationships, offering customized solutions, and maintaining flexible production capabilities to meet diverse customer demands amid geopolitical and trade uncertainties.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of the latest fiscal year, WUS reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$33.32 billion with a slight decline compared to the previous year. The company maintains a stable financial structure with total assets around NT$150 billion and equity of about NT$99 billion. Despite operating losses at the operating level, it achieved a net profit after tax of approximately NT$777 million, supported by non-operating income. The firm invests about 1.5-2% of revenue in R&D and plans moderate sales growth of 10-20% in the coming year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: WUS emphasizes delivering high-quality, technologically advanced PCB products with stable performance and high yield rates. Its value proposition includes strong R&D capabilities, flexible and timely customer service, and a commitment to sustainable and green manufacturing practices. The company differentiates itself through customized product development, integration of smart manufacturing, and adherence to stringent quality and environmental standards.
